result.title: AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation
result.summary: Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation. In a four-way ablation trained for 1,000 steps with three independent seeds, the full method lowers KLT forward-backward cycle error in all three seeds relative to a matched flow-only continuation (mean seed-level difference -0.00711, SD 0.00505), while robust sharpness remains positive in all three. An expanded 24-prompt evaluation (216 videos) yields 9.7% lower aggregate CoTracker3 cycle error than the matched control and near-matched performance on six VBench dimensions; however, the seed-level tracking effect is heterogeneous and I3D-FVD regresses from 0.1824 to 0.2022. These results support a bounded claim: conflict-aware adaptation improves correspondence consistency without broad perceptual degradation, but does not uniformly improve video quality. We release equations, pseudocode, matched outputs, source tables, and artifact provenance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在 5.01B 文本到视频扩散 transformer 上引入显式点对应监督时的张力，提出置信度加权的轨迹与可见性头、零初始化残差反馈和非对称 PCGrad，并报告 1000 步多种子消融与 24 提示评测的轨迹误差和 VBench 表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其非对称 PCGrad 只在共享 LoRA 参数上剔除与主目标是冲突的辅助梯度分量，可能为 LVR 中辅助视觉监督与主推理目标的贡献分配及梯度冲突缓解提供训练期线索，可供核查是否可迁移到 latent 状态训练。
